description:
**Pay: 20,000.00 - 30,000.00 per month**

**Job description:**

**Title : E-Commerce Inventory & Marketplace operations Executive**

**Salary Scale : 20K to 30K**

**Department: Warehouse**

**Location: Wagholi, Pune, Maharashtra**

**Experience - 2 - 4 years**

· Manage inventory across **Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Vendor Central, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, and other e-commerce marketplaces**.

· Monitor daily inventory levels, sales velocity, stock cover, sell-through, and out-of-stock risks across all SKUs.

· Prepare **inventory forecasts and replenishment plans** based on historical sales, upcoming promotions, seasonality, marketplace events, and business targets.

· Track and process **Amazon Vendor Central POs**, including PO acceptance, quantities, shortages, dispatch planning, ASN coordination, and delivery timelines.

· Ensure optimum inventory availability while avoiding **overstock, dead stock, stock-outs, excess inventory, and unnecessary storage charges**.

· Coordinate closely with the **manufacturing team** and issue **production/work orders** based on marketplace demand, sales forecasts, inventory levels, pending orders, and upcoming campaigns.

· Prepare SKU-wise **stock ageing, inventory health, slow-moving stock, fast-moving stock, and dead-stock reports**.

· Plan inventory ahead of major events such as **Prime Day, Great Indian Festival, Big Billion Days, Diwali, festive campaigns, sale events, and promotional periods**.

· Track inbound shipments and ensure stocks reach fulfilment centers within required timelines.

· Identify inventory risks in advance and take corrective action before they impact sales.

· Manage **returns, replacements, RTOs, damages, and defective products** across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, and other marketplaces.

· Track returned inventory from pickup to warehouse receipt and ensure proper reconciliation.

· Raise and follow up on **claims, reimbursements, SAFE-T cases, shortages, and transit damage cases**.

· Prepare daily/weekly MIS for **return rate, replacement rate, claim recovery, and inventory losses**.

· Reduce avoidable returns through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

**Key Skills Required**

* Amazon Seller Central
* Amazon Vendor Central

* Myntra Partner Portal
* Meesho Supplier Panel

* Return Reason Analysis
* Root Cause Analysis
* Quality Issue Identification
* Warehouse Coordination
* Manufacturing Coordination
* Production / Rework Work Orders
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets
* MIS Reporting
* Strong analytical and follow-up skills

The candidate will assist with maintaining accurate financial records, processing invoices, tracking expenses, reconciling transactions, and supporting routine accounting activities across the company's outlets.

title: E-Commerce Associate
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Data Entry Executive with e-commerce and AI skills to join our growing team in India. The candidate will be responsible for entering, updating, organizing, and maintaining product data, customer records, supplier details, spreadsheets, digital files, and information on the company’s e-commerce website.

The candidate will regularly upload new products, update existing listings, make website content changes, organize product categories, manage images and specifications, and ensure that all online product information is complete, accurate, and professionally presented.

The ideal candidate should be accurate, organized, consistent, and able to follow instructions carefully. They should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, organize information, prepare product content, identify errors, and complete routine administrative and e-commerce tasks more efficiently.

AI tools should be used to support the work, but all information must be manually reviewed and verified before publishing.

Key Responsibilities

**Data Entry:** Enter and update product details, prices, descriptions, specifications, customer information, supplier records, and other company data accurately.

**E-Commerce Product Uploads:** Upload new products to the company’s e-commerce website, including product names, descriptions, prices, specifications, dimensions, materials, colours, finishes, images, categories, and other required information.

**Product Listing Management:** Update and maintain existing product listings, correct inaccurate information, replace images, revise descriptions, add new specifications, and ensure all listings remain complete and up to date.

**Website Content Updates:** Make routine changes to website content, product pages, categories, collections, banners, links, downloadable documents, and other sections when required.

**Product Categories and Variations:** Organize products under the correct categories and manage product options or variations such as size, colour, finish, material, configuration, and model.

**Pricing and Availability Updates:** Update product prices, promotional information, availability, stock status, and other commercial details based on approved instructions.

**Product Image Management:** Upload, rename, resize, organize, replace, and arrange product images to ensure they are displayed clearly and correctly on the website.

**Website Quality Checking:** Review published product pages to confirm that images, descriptions, prices, specifications, variations, links, and page layouts are displaying correctly.

**Excel and Google Sheets:** Maintain spreadsheets, organize information, check records for accuracy, apply formulas, remove duplicate entries, and ensure data is formatted correctly.

**AI-Assisted Data Processing:** Use AI tools to help organize large amounts of information, structure unformatted data, summarize documents, categorize records, and convert rough information into clear and usable formats.

**AI-Assisted Product Content:** Use AI tools to help prepare, rewrite, shorten, standardize, or improve product names, descriptions, specifications, and website content while maintaining factual and technical accuracy.

**Data Cleaning and Standardization:** Use spreadsheet functions and AI-assisted tools to identify missing information, formatting inconsistencies, duplicate entries, spelling errors, and incorrect data.

**Basic E-Commerce SEO Support:** Assist with preparing clear product titles, descriptions, categories, image names, page information, and search-friendly content based on company guidelines.

**File Management:** Organize digital files, folders, product images, documents, spreadsheets, and internal records in a clear and structured manner.

**Document Processing:** Extract and organize information from PDFs, quotations, supplier documents, catalogues, images, and other files using appropriate digital and AI tools.

**Administrative Support:**  
Support the office, sales, marketing, purchasing, and operations teams with basic back-office, website, and administrative tasks.

**Quality Checking:** Review all entered, uploaded, and AI-generated information carefully to identify errors, correct mistakes, and ensure records are complete and accurate.

**AI Output Verification:** Check all AI-generated content before use. Ensure that product specifications, dimensions, prices, customer details, supplier information, and technical data have not been incorrectly changed or invented.

**Data Confidentiality:** Handle customer, supplier, pricing, product, website, and company information responsibly and maintain confidentiality at all times.

Requirements & Qualifications

**Experience:** Minimum 4–5 years of experience in data entry, e-commerce operations, website product uploading, back-office operations, administration, product data management, or a similar role.

**E-Commerce Experience:** Previous experience uploading and maintaining products on an e-commerce website or content management system is preferred.

**Product Data Skills:** Ability to understand and organize product names, descriptions, dimensions, specifications, materials, finishes, images, prices, categories, and variations.

**Data Entry Skills:** Good typing speed, strong accuracy, and the ability to enter and update large amounts of information consistently.

**Excel and Google Sheets:** Good working knowledge of spreadsheets, including formatting, sorting, filtering, formulas, data validation, duplicate removal, and basic data analysis.

**AI Skills:** Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar platforms to organize information, improve written content, assist with spreadsheet work, and increase productivity.

**AI Prompting:** Ability to write clear instructions and prompts to generate accurate, structured, and relevant outputs.

**English Requirement:** Excellent English reading, writing, verbal communication, and comprehension skills are required. The candidate must be able to understand product information, website instructions, internal processes, and written feedback and communicate professionally in English.

**Attention to Detail:** Must be able to check information carefully, identify errors, compare website listings against original sources, and avoid mistakes.

**Organization:** Must be able to maintain clean records, structured folders, properly named files, accurately updated spreadsheets, and organized website listings.

**Technology:** Must be comfortable learning new e-commerce platforms, content management systems, company software, AI tools, and digital workflows.

**Attitude:** Reliable, punctual, focused, responsible, willing to learn, and able to follow instructions and complete tasks within agreed timelines.

**Why Join Us?**

Stable office-based role with opportunities for professional growth.

Opportunity to gain practical experience in e-commerce website management, product uploading, data entry, and digital operations.

Opportunity to develop practical experience using AI tools in product management, website content, and business operations.

Supportive team environment where accuracy, efficiency, consistency, communication, and responsibility are recognized.

Opportunity to work with product data and e-commerce operations for a growing office furniture company.

description:
Job DescriptionArea Sales Manager (ASM) – Beverage Division

**Department:** Sales & Distribution  
**Designation:** Area Sales Manager (ASM)  
**Industry:** Beverages / FMCG  
**Location:** Pune Region  
**Reporting To:** Regional Sales Manager / Sales Head  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and result-oriented **Area Sales Manager (ASM)** to lead sales and distribution activities for our beverage portfolio across an assigned territory.

The ASM will be responsible for developing the distribution network, managing distributors and sales representatives, driving secondary and primary sales, expanding retail presence, and ensuring strong visibility of products across the market.

The ideal candidate should have experience in **FMCG, beverages, food products, or consumer goods**, with strong knowledge of general trade and distributor-led sales.

Key Responsibilities1. Sales & Target Achievement

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the assigned territory.
* Develop and execute territory-wise sales plans.
* Drive primary sales to distributors and secondary sales through retail outlets.
* Identify opportunities to increase sales volume, market penetration, and product availability.
* Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions.

2. Distributor Management

* Appoint, develop, and manage distributors across the assigned territory.
* Maintain strong relationships with distributors, super-stockists, and key channel partners.
* Ensure adequate stock availability at distributor points.
* Monitor distributor inventory, billing, collections, and stock movement.
* Coordinate with distributors to improve market coverage and outlet servicing.

3. Market Expansion

* Identify and develop new markets and territories.
* Expand the company's retail network by onboarding new outlets.
* Develop coverage across supermarkets, grocery stores, convenience stores, cafés, restaurants, institutional buyers, and other relevant channels.
* Identify potential distributors and channel partners in uncovered areas.
* Conduct regular market visits to understand competition, pricing, consumer demand, and market trends.

4. Team Management

* Manage and guide Sales Officers, Sales Executives, and field sales representatives.
* Set daily and monthly targets for the sales team.
* Monitor beat plans, outlet coverage, productive calls, and order generation.
* Conduct regular team meetings and market reviews.
* Train the team on products, selling techniques, schemes, and market execution.

5. Retail & Visibility

* Ensure availability of all assigned SKUs at retail outlets.
* Improve product visibility through displays, racks, branding, POSM, and promotional activities.
* Ensure proper execution of company schemes and trade promotions.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing, promotions, and new product launches.
* Ensure proper FIFO/FEFO stock rotation wherever applicable.

6. Market Intelligence

* Track competitor brands, pricing, schemes, product launches, and distribution strategies.
* Gather feedback from distributors, retailers, and consumers.
* Identify high-potential outlets and emerging market opportunities.
* Prepare regular market and competitor reports for management.

7. Collections & Commercial Control

* Monitor distributor outstanding payments and ensure timely collections.
* Maintain healthy distributor credit and stock levels.
* Coordinate with the finance team regarding outstanding payments and credit limits.
* Minimize expiry, damage, leakage, and slow-moving inventory.

8. Reporting

* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly sales reports.
* Track primary and secondary sales.
* Report distributor-wise and territory-wise performance.
* Submit market visit reports and competitor activity reports.
* Maintain accurate records of outlet coverage, new outlet additions, and sales productivity.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of **FMCG/beverage sales and distribution**.
* Good knowledge of distributor and retail networks.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage and motivate a field sales team.
* Strong market development and relationship-management skills.
* Target-oriented and commercially driven approach.
* Good analytical and reporting skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and sales reporting tools.

Educational Qualification

* Graduate degree in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an advantage.

Experience

**Preferred:** 2–5 years of experience in FMCG, beverages, food & beverage, or consumer products sales.

Candidates with strong experience in **general trade, distributor management, and territory expansion** will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Primary sales achievement
* Secondary sales achievement
* New distributor appointments
* New outlet additions
* Retail outlet coverage
* Numeric distribution
* SKU-wise availability
* Distributor productivity
* Sales team productivity
* Collection efficiency
* Market expansion
* Product visibility and execution
* Reduction in expiry/damage/returns

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a **hands-on field sales professional** who understands how FMCG products move from the company → distributor → retailer → consumer.

The candidate should be comfortable spending significant time in the market, building relationships with distributors and retailers, opening new outlets, managing sales teams, and aggressively expanding the company's presence within the assigned territory.

**Compensation:** ₹25000 – ₹27000 per month+ performance incentives + travel allowance/TA-DA, as applicable.

description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

The Sales Development Representative (SDR), based in Pune, is a dedicated pipeline-generation engine for OpenGov's US go-to-market team. This role is built for outbound specialists who want to master high-volume prospecting into the US public sector market, working US-aligned hours to connect directly with government decision-makers in real time. You'll partner closely with US-based Sales Development Representatives and Account Executives to build and qualify pipeline.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Generate pipeline for the US market: run high-volume outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach into assigned US territories (cities, counties, special districts, and state agencies)
* Work US-aligned hours: align your schedule to the US territories you support so you're reaching decision-makers in real time
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads against OpenGov's ICP and hand off sales-ready opportunities to US-based Account Executives
* Build enough fluency in OpenGov's cloud-based platform to speak credibly about the problems it solves for cities, counties, and government agencies
* Use Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn daily to manage pipeline, prioritize leads, and log activity with precision
* Clearly and persuasively articulate OpenGov's value to US government decision-makers and quickly establish credibility
* Hit weekly outbound activity and pipeline targets while staying disciplined about lead quality
* Collaborate with marketing by following up on inbound and campaign-generated leads to maximize lead-to-opportunity conversion
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce for all prospecting activity

**Requirements and Preferred Experience:**
------------------------------------------

* 2 to 4 years of experience in **SDR, Sales** or a customer-facing role
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to cold-call US-based government decision-makers and quickly build rapport
* Comfortable working US-aligned hours from Pune
* A natural communicator who's confident talking to people you've never met, and knows how to make them glad you called
* Genuinely curious about technology and its role in government, with a competitive drive and real passion for pushing the public sector forward
* Excited by AI and what it means for government: able to speak to it credibly and see it as a differentiator in every conversation
* Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce or similar) is a plus
* Background in B2B, SaaS, outbound prospecting, BPO, or government is a bonus, but not expected at this level
* Bachelor's degree preferred

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
Location: Pune

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 14, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1676419

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**

**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**

Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM · Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**

**Senior/Manager**

**EXPERIENCE**

**8–12 years**

**LOCATION**

**EY GDS · Hybrid**

**ORIENTATION**

**Strategy-led**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
===================

  

We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.

You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.

**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**

**40%**

**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**

Win themes, solution storyline, client orals

**30%**

**Go-To-Market & Offerings**

Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances

**30%**

**AI Strategy & Advisory**

Roadmaps, business cases, operating models

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
=============================

**AI Strategy & Value Advisory**
--------------------------------

* Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.

* Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery MVP scale).

* Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.

* Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.

**Go-To-Market & Offering Development**
---------------------------------------

* Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.

* Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.

* Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.

* Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.

* Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.

**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
------------------------------

* Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.

* Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.

* Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.

* Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.

* Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.

**AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)**
---------------------------------------------

* Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.

* Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.

* Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.

* Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.

**Business Development & Client Management**
--------------------------------------------

* Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.

* Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.

* Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**
-----------------------------------

* Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.

* Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.

* Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.

**SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES**
=========================

**Educational Background**
--------------------------

* MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.

**Professional Experience**
---------------------------

* 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.

* Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.

* Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.

* Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.

* Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.

* Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.

* Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)

* Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.

* APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.

**IDEAL PROFILE**
=================

**You will thrive here if you…**

* Have taken AI / data products from 0 1 and know what drives adoption

* Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal

* Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO

* Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs

**This role is not…**

* A hands-on engineering or model-building role

* Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks

* Pure delivery / project management

* A back-office bid-desk formatting role

**WHY JOIN US**
===============

  

* Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.

* Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.

* Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
=================

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning** — You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

* **Success as defined by you** — We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

* **Transformative leadership** — We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

* **Diverse and inclusive culture** — You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales Technical Consultant / Developer with deep expertise in Dynamics 365 Sales, Sales Insights, Copilot for Sales, Power Platform, Dataverse, and Power Apps Component Framework (PCF). The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade CRM solutions that enhance sales productivity, customer engagement, and business process automation.

  

* **Role: MS D365 CRM Sales Developer**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, configure, customize, and enhance Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales solutions.
* Implement and support Lead, Opportunity, Account, Contact, Activity, and Sales Process Management capabilities.
* Configure entities, Dataverse tables, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, security roles, and relationships.

* Develop plugins, custom APIs, actions, workflows, and server-side extensions using C# and .NET.
* Integrate Dynamics 365 Sales with enterprise applications, Microsoft services, and third-party platforms.
* Participate in solution architecture, design reviews, testing, deployment, and production support activities.
* Troubleshoot integration, performance, scalability, and security-related issues.
* Mentor junior developers and establish development standards and best practices.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8–12 years of CRM and enterprise application development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales implementations.
* Expertise across Leads, Opportunities, Accounts, Contacts, Activities, and Sales Processes.
* Experience configuring forms, views, dashboards, business process flows, workflows, and security models.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture and CRM customization techniques.

* Knowledge of Sales Assistant, Auto Capture, Email Engagement, Relationship Analytics, and Conversation Intelligence.
* Understanding of security, licensing, privacy, and data governance considerations within Sales Insights.
* Ability to translate sales analytics into business value and productivity improvements.
* Hands-on experience implementing and supporting Copilot for Sales solutions.
* Experience integrating Dynamics 365 Sales with Microsoft 365 applications.
* Knowledge of opportunity summaries, lead intelligence, account insights, record updates, and seller productivity scenarios.
* Understanding of AI governance, security, access controls, and responsible AI implementation practices.
* Strong experience building solutions using Power Apps, Dataverse, and Power Automate.
* Expertise in Dataverse entities, tables, relationships, business rules, security models, and automation frameworks.
* Experience developing enterprise-grade Power Automate workflows and integrations.
* Strong understanding of Power Platform governance and ALM processes.
* Hands-on experience developing reusable Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) controls.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS.
* Experience integrating PCF controls with Dataverse and Dynamics 365 applications.
* Expertise in optimizing component performance, usability, and maintainability.
* Experience developing Dynamics 365 extensions using JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, and .NET.

* Experience designing and implementing enterprise integrations.

* Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills.
* Experience participating in architecture and design discussions.
* Ability to work directly with business stakeholders and translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Strong mentoring, stakeholder management, and communication abilities.
* Experience delivering scalable and enterprise-grade CRM solutions.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups

description:
**WE ARE HIRINGTELEPHONIC SALES EXECUTIVE**

**Location:** The Spirited Spot, Eleven West, Baner, Pune  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Sales & Guest Relations

**ABOUT THE SPIRITED SPOT**

The Spirited Spot (TSS) is a premium cocktail-forward bar known for its signature cocktails, global street food, live music and vibrant atmosphere.

After establishing our presence in Nagpur, we have expanded to Baner, Pune, bringing together exceptional food, innovative cocktails, live entertainment and warm hospitality.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and result-oriented **Telephonic Sales Executive** who can connect with potential guests, promote our experiences and convert enquiries into confirmed reservations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Lead Calling & Conversion**

* Call potential customers who enquire through Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and digital marketing campaigns.
* Explain TSS offerings, events, promotions and experiences.
* Convert enquiries into confirmed table reservations.
* Follow up with interested customers to maximise conversions.
* Maintain a professional and friendly approach during every interaction.

**2. Reservation & Sales Management**

* Generate table bookings for weekdays and weekends.
* Promote live music nights, Sunday brunch, special events and group bookings.
* Encourage guests to visit TSS for birthdays, celebrations and corporate gatherings.
* Coordinate with the reservation and operations teams to ensure smooth guest experiences.
* Follow up on bookings to minimise cancellations and no-shows.

**3. Customer Relationship Management**

* Maintain an organised database of leads and customer enquiries.
* Build relationships with existing and potential customers.
* Reconnect with previous guests to encourage repeat visits.
* Handle customer questions professionally and provide accurate information.

**4. Daily Reporting & Performance**

* Maintain daily records of calls, follow-ups and confirmed reservations.
* Track leads received, leads contacted and successful conversions.
* Share daily sales and reservation reports with management.
* Achieve individual calling, reservation and conversion targets.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Minimum 1–2 years of experience in telecalling, telesales, customer service or hospitality sales.
* Experience in restaurants, bars, hotels, hospitality or event sales will be preferred.
* Good communication skills in **English, Hindi and Marathi**.
* Confident, polite and persuasive communication style.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp Business, Excel and basic CRM tools.
* Ability to handle customer enquiries and sales objections.
* Target-oriented attitude with strong follow-up skills.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

We are looking for someone who:

* Enjoys speaking with people and building relationships.
* Can confidently convert enquiries into reservations.
* Understands the importance of customer service.
* Is proactive, organised and consistent with follow-ups.
* Can work in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
* Is comfortable working on weekends and during important events.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of leads contacted daily.
* Lead-to-reservation conversion percentage.
* Number of confirmed reservations generated.
* Actual guest footfall generated through calling.
* Repeat reservations and customer engagement.

title: Manager, SDR
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

The SDR Manager, based in Pune, leads a team of Sales Development Representatives dedicated to generating pipeline for OpenGov's US go-to-market team. This role owns the performance, coaching, and day to day execution of the Pune SDR team, ensuring consistent, high quality outbound activity into the US public sector market. You'll report to a US-based Director of Sales Development and act as the connective tissue between the Pune team and US leadership, translating strategy into daily execution and results.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Manage and coach a team of 6 SDRs so they consistently hit pipeline and activity targets
* Monitor individual and team metrics (calls, emails, meetings booked, pipeline generated) and run regular one on one meetings and performance reviews
* Translate US GTM strategy and territory priorities from US leadership into daily and weekly execution plans for the Pune team
* Build onboarding, ramp plans, and ongoing skill development programs so new SDRs reach full productivity quickly
* Partner closely with the US-based Director of Sales Development and US Account Executives to align on lead quality, handoff process, and feedback loops
* Ensure the team uses Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn effectively, and maintain clean, accurate reporting for leadership
* Manage a team working US-aligned hours from Pune, including shift scheduling and coverage planning
* Deliver regular updates to US leadership on team performance, pipeline health, and areas for improvement
* Build a high energy, competitive, and supportive team culture that keeps SDRs engaged and motivated

**Requirements and Preferred Experience:**
------------------------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in sales development or outbound sales, including a proven track record managing SDR or BDR teams
* Experience managing a team that supports a US market or works US-aligned hours
* Strong coaching skills, with a track record of developing reps and improving individual performance
* Comfortable working US-aligned hours from Pune
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate effectively with US-based leadership and stakeholders
* A data driven approach to managing pipeline and activity metrics, with fluency in Salesforce and sales engagement tools (Outreach or similar)
* Genuinely curious about technology and its role in government, with the ability to translate that curiosity into team level coaching
* Background in B2B, SaaS, BPO, or government focused sales organizations is a strong plus
* Bachelor's degree preferred

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Senior Enterprise Sales Lead
description:
**Senior Enterprise Sales Lead**

**The role:**

Fonazo is hiring a Senior Enterprise Sales Lead to open, close, and expand accounts with the largest companies in every market Fonazo serves.

Fonazo is an AI Voice Agent Builder. A business describes the agent it needs and launches it in about two minutes. Every agent carries its own phone number, speaks 76 languages with mid-call switching, reads emotion, sends WhatsApp and SMS in real time, connects to CRM and calendar systems, and reports every call through Fonazo Analytics. The Global Compliance Engine is live in India, the US, the UK, Germany, and France. Pricing is published in INR, USD, EUR, and GBP.

The mandate has two halves. First, win the top companies in BFSI, healthcare, real estate, logistics, ecommerce, hospitality, and government. Second, take Fonazo everywhere inside them: one domain goes live, is handed to the delivery team with a complete brief, and the next domain in the same account opens.

Reports to - Founder and CEO

Base - Pune, India, with a global territory

Type - Full time

Experience - 6+ years closing enterprise software deals

Markets - India, UAE, US, UK, France, Germany, Spain, Italy

**What the role owns:**

* The full enterprise cycle: target list, C-suite outreach, discovery, live demo, commercial proposal, security and compliance review, negotiation, signature.
* Direct relationships with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and heads of customer operations at the top companies in each vertical.
* A cost-avoidance business case for every deal, built on the buyer's own call volumes, staffing cost, and conversion numbers.
* Live demos where an agent is built in front of the buyer in two minutes, in the buyer's language, for the buyer's use case.
* Compliance conversations with legal, risk, and procurement teams, presenting the controls Fonazo enforces in each country.
* Account expansion from the first domain to every domain where a phone call happens.
* A clean, accurate pipeline and forecast in the CRM, reviewed weekly with the CEO.
* Market feedback to product: what enterprises ask for, what blocks deals, what competitors quote.

**The handover model:**

Every account follows the same five steps, and the seller owns the first, second, and fifth.

1. Land. Close one domain with a named executive sponsor, for example collections, lead qualification, appointment booking, or customer support.

2. Hand over. Deliver a complete brief to the Forward Deployed Engineering team within 48 hours of signature: use case, call flows, languages, integrations required, compliance scope, success metrics, and stakeholder map.

3. Go live. The delivery team deploys. The seller stays on the executive relationship and out of the build.

4. Prove. Fonazo Analytics produces the results the sponsor committed to internally.

5. Expand. Take those results to the next domain owner in the same company and repeat from step one.

A handover is complete when the delivery team can start work without a single clarifying question to the customer.

**What the candidate brings:**

* 6+ years closing enterprise software or infrastructure deals, with a documented record against quota.
* Personal experience selling to C-suite buyers in at least one of BFSI, healthcare, telecom, BPO, or large-scale consumer operations.
* Experience in a contact centre, conversational AI, CPaaS, CCaaS, or voice technology sale is a strong advantage.
* Proof of land and expand: at least two accounts grown from one business unit to several.
* Comfort in regulated sales cycles involving information security reviews, data protection addenda, and procurement.
* Financial fluency to build and defend an ROI model in front of a CFO.
* Written and spoken English at boardroom standard. Hindi, Arabic, German, French, Spanish, or Italian is an advantage.
* An existing network of enterprise decision makers in at least one Fonazo market.

**What success looks like:**

Timeframe - Outcome

30 days - Product mastery, a live demo delivered unaided, and a named target list of 50 enterprise accounts

90 days - 10 executive-level opportunities in active evaluation and the first enterprise contract signed

180 days - First account expanded into a second domain, with a repeatable handover brief used by the delivery team

12 months - A portfolio of multi-domain enterprise accounts across at least two countries

**Why this role:**

* A product that demos itself: the buyer watches a working agent appear in two minutes.
* Published pricing in four currencies that wins on cost in every market.
* Compliance controls already live in five countries, which shortens legal review.
* Direct line to the founder, with authority to shape enterprise pricing, packaging, and partnerships.
* Fixed pay plus uncapped commission, with accelerators on multi-domain expansion.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

You will be the person who makes sure an order goes right after the customer says yes: chasing our factories for production and dispatch, and looking after our overseas customers until the goods are delivered and any issue is closed.

Company

India Pack (indiapack.co.in)

Reports to - Co-founder

Working days - Mon–Sat (Sundays Off)

About India Pack

India Pack is a Pune-based B2B packaging sourcing company, now about 10 years old. We supply FIBCs (jumbo bags), PP woven bags, BOPP bags, flexible pouches and container liners from 10+ audited Indian manufacturers to buyers in the UK, Germany, Scandinavia, the USA and the Middle East.

What you will do

**After-sales support (customers)**

* Be the day-to-day contact for international customers once an order is confirmed: order status, dispatch dates, shipping documents.
* Send shipment updates before the customer has to ask, and confirm delivery at their end.
* Share and file order documents: invoice, packing list, bill of lading, test reports and certificates.
* Register every complaint or quality claim the day it arrives. Collect photos, quantities, batch details and usage conditions from the customer.
* Work with the supplier and our technical team to find the cause, agree the corrective action, and keep the customer updated until the claim is closed.
* Follow up after delivery for feedback and pass repeat-order signals to the sales team.

**Supplier coordination (factories)**

* Follow up with our manufacturing partners by phone and email on production schedules, samples, print proofs and dispatch readiness.
* Track each order from purchase order to shipment and keep the order tracker and ERP/CRM up to date.
* Flag delays or spec deviations early, with a revised date and a proposed fix, not just the problem.
* Coordinate pre-shipment inspections and check test reports against the customer's specification.
* Collect supplier documents on time so that shipping paperwork is never the reason for a delay.

**Reporting**

* Maintain the open-orders and open-claims lists and present a short status every week.

Who we are looking for

**Must have**

* A graduate in any stream (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc, BE or a diploma are all fine).
* Clear, polite written English. Most of your day is email with overseas customers.
* Comfortable speaking Hindi on the phone with factory teams.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: filters, sorting, simple formulas.
* A habit of following up without being reminded, and of writing things down.
* Calm with an unhappy customer: you listen, collect the facts, and respond the same day.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to export documentation, Incoterms or freight forwarding.
* A background in packaging, plastics, textiles or any manufacturing environment.
* Experience with an ERP or CRM or a shared helpdesk inbox.
* Gujarati or Marathi for supplier conversations.

What you will get

* Daily, direct work with customers in Europe, the USA and the Middle East from your first month.
* Hands-on training in FIBC and woven packaging products, quality standards and the export process from order to delivery.
* A small team where you work directly with the founders and your work is visible.
* A growth path to Account Manager, owning a set of customers and suppliers end to end.

**About The Role:**

The Sell Director is one of the most senior leaders in the Customer Experience organisation, accountable for the full performance of the Sell domain and for outcomes that roll up to the overall CX organisation: CSAT, SLA performance and Cost of Support.


This role owns the operating model, people decisions, quality standards, KPI performance and transformation agenda for the Sell domain. A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Sell domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.
* Own the operational KPIs that drive those outcomes: First Reply, Next Reply, First Contact Resolution, Reopen Rate and Abandoned Call performance.
* Own hiring, promotion, performance management and termination decisions across the domain, within company and HR policy.
* Ensure support quality is maintained through clear standards, coaching, knowledge use, escalation handling and customer communication.
* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.


* Prioritise SME work based on customer impact, ticket demand, product complexity, BPO readiness and AI adoption opportunities.
* Ensure SME outputs flow into training, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, QA calibration, macros, escalation logic and AI knowledge sources.
Create a simple governance rhythm for SME output, including knowledge gaps, training needs, AI content improvements and measurable impact on CSAT, SLA, FCR, reopens and cost. This may look like following the KCS standard, or other such framework.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience in customer experience, customer support, contact\-centre operations or comparable service delivery environments.
* Equivalent experience is valued where the individual has demonstrated ownership of large\-scale operational outcomes, multi\-level teams, financial performance, customer experience quality and specialist knowledge\-management capability.
* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Sell.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience is a relationship and governance role, not a target\-carrying operations role. You own the mechanism that makes the partnership work: the reporting, cadence, coordination, and health of the relationship. The delivery targets themselves (service levels, quality and cost) sit with the operational leaders. Your job is to make sure the partner always knows what is expected and where they stand, and that Cyncly leaders always have an accurate, current picture of the performance outputs of the BPO. Leaders such as our CX Domain Directors, SVP CX, CCO, and wider executive members.


We work with a strategic outsourcing (BPO) partner to deliver customer support across multiple domains, product lines, and regions. This role is the single point of contact between Cyncly and that partner.


You will keep a clear, consistent, and trusted view of how the relationship is performing, so that everyone on both sides always knows where things stand. You will stand the partnership up through transition and go\-live and then run the ongoing relationship day to day.


The role is designed to expand as trust is earned: at the start, you stand up the mechanism, get reporting flowing, establish the governance cadence and make the transition land cleanly; as the relationship settles, you move from reactive to proactive by anticipating risks, championing change and building a genuine joint team; and in the mature relationship, you become a true partnership steward, keeping leadership sponsorship sharp and the relationship healthy and honest. The through\-line is a move from running the reporting to making the partnership succeed.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Act as the single point of contact for Cyncly's outsourcing partner across operational, reporting and relationship matters.
* Build and run the governance rhythm, including performance reporting, review meetings, quarterly business reviews, agendas, minutes, and action tracking.
* Produce clear, accurate performance reporting and maintain one consistent view of how the partnership is performing, creating a single trusted version rather than different stories across the business.
* Route and coordinate escalations to the right owners and drive them through to resolution.
* Coordinate capacity, workforce planning, and forecasting between partner and internal teams.
* Track risks, actions, issues and decisions, and surface emerging risks early.
* Lead Cyncly's side of the transition and go\-live, partnering closely with the provider's transition team, then carrying the relationship into a steady state.
Champion continuous improvement and a genuine one\-team relationship built on trust and honest communication rather than adversarial vendor management.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Typically 8 to 14 years of experience in customer experience, contact center or BPO delivery, including experience managing or governing an outsourced engagement from the client side.
* Equivalent experience is valued; formal project, programme or partnership\-management credentials are welcomed where they support the role, but are not the primary requirement.
* Strong governance, project and relationship\-management discipline across cadence, reporting, risk tracking and stakeholder communication.
* Credibility and presence to hold governance with senior stakeholders on both sides, and to represent the business well.
* Solid grounding in contact\-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, customer satisfaction and quality, so you can coordinate meaningfully and interrogate the numbers.
* Comfort working with delivery data and reporting tools, and manipulating such data to be presented in a variety of formats to varying stakeholders of varying seniority
* Experience with Zendesk or a comparable ITSM/CCaaS customer service platform(s).
* Ability to create trust, maintain clarity, and build a one\-team relationship with an outsourcing partner while keeping accountability clear.
* Experience working in global teams \& managing stakeholders across geographies.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience standing up or transitioning outsourced engagement, with exposure to commercial negotiations and management.
* A project or programme management background, for example PMP certification.
Experience across multiple regions and product areas.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. If you are comfortable speaking with people over the phone, have good communication skills, and are target\-oriented, this role is suitable for you.

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# Calling \& Lead Generation

\* Make \*\*outbound calls\*\* to prospective customers from the company's lead database.

\* Make approximately \*\*80–120 calls per day\*\*, depending on lead availability.

\* Introduce the company's products/services clearly and professionally.

\* Understand customer requirements and identify potential opportunities.

\* Explain product/service features, pricing, offers, and benefits.

\* Generate interest and qualify leads.

\#\#\# Follow\-Up \& Conversion

\* Follow up with interested customers through \*\*phone calls and WhatsApp\*\*.

\* Handle customer questions, objections, and basic concerns.

\* Schedule meetings/demos/callbacks whenever required.

\* Convert qualified leads into customers.

\#\#\#

CRM \& Reporting

\* Update every lead and call outcome in the \*\*CRM system\*\*.

\* Maintain accurate information such as:

\* New Lead

\* Connected

\* Not Connected

\* Interested

\* Follow\-up Required

\* Meeting Scheduled

\* Converted

\* Not Interested

\* Maintain daily calling and follow\-up reports.

\* Share daily performance updates with the reporting manager.

\#\# Daily Responsibilities

A typical day may include:

\*\*Morning\*\*

\* Check assigned leads.

\* Review pending follow\-ups.

\* Prioritize high\-potential leads.

\*\*During the Day\*\*

\* Make outbound calls.

\* Speak with prospects.

\* Understand their requirements.

\* Explain the product/service.

\* Handle objections.

\* Schedule meetings or demos.

\* Follow up with previous leads.

\* Update CRM after every interaction.

\*\*End of Day\*\*

\* Complete pending follow\-ups.

\* Update CRM.

\* Prepare daily calling report.

\* Share lead/conversion status with the manager.

\#\# Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

\* Number of calls made.

\* Call connection rate.

\* Qualified leads generated.

\* Follow\-ups completed.

\* Meetings/demos scheduled.

\* Leads converted.

\* Revenue generated.

\* CRM data accuracy.

\* Daily attendance and punctuality.

\* Marathi communication will be an added advantage.

\* Confident and polite while speaking with customers.

\* Ability to use WhatsApp and CRM software.

\* Good listening and convincing skills.

Prior experience in \*\*telecalling, telesales, BPO, inside sales, customer support, lead generation, or business development\*\* will be an advantage.

title: Value Realization Manager
description:
**Who are we?**


Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it’s not just about *finding risk but* *remediating* it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.


We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies, including Siemens, Airbus, Salesforce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a \*\*Value Realization Manager\*\* to join our Revenue Operations team. This is a newly created role focused on one clear mission: making sure the GTM technology we've invested in—Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar GTM platforms—actually delivers the business outcomes it was purchased for.


You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, Sales Enablement, and Vendor Management. Rather than just administering tools, you'll own the \*value\* they generate: adoption, ROI, workflow efficiency, and measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. If you've spent time as a customer success manager on the vendor side of GTM tech and are ready to apply that customer success discipline internally, this role is built for you.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own the end\-to\-end value realization strategy for our core GTM tech stack (Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and call recorder tools such as Kaia or Clari Copilot)
* Define and track adoption metrics, usage benchmarks, and ROI models for each platform; report regularly to RevOps and Sales leadership
* Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, Business Application, and IT teams to ensure tools are configured, integrated, and used the way they were intended
* Identify underutilized features or workflows and drive targeted enablement to close the gap
* Act as the internal "CSM" for each vendor relationship—running regular business reviews, escalating issues, and holding vendors accountable to their own value promises
* Build and maintain a value realization scorecard/dashboard that ties tool usage to pipeline, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity outcomes
* Lead onboarding and change management for new tool rollouts or major feature releases
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback from sales reps and managers to continuously improve stack ROI
* Serve as the primary point of contact for renewal and expansion conversations, providing usage data and value evidence to inform commercial decisions

  

Requirements:
  

* 3\+ years of experience in customer success, revenue operations, sales enablement, or a related GTM function
* Direct hands\-on experience with at least 2 of the following: Call Recorder Tool, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Strong communication and presentation skills—comfortable in front of sales reps, frontline managers, and executive leadership alike
* Strong analytical skills—comfortable building dashboards, interpreting usage data, and translating numbers into a business narrative
* Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence sales leaders and reps without direct authority

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Prior experience as a \*\*Customer Success Manager at Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn—you know these tools from the vendor side and understand how to extract maximum value from them
* Familiarity with GTM tech stack architecture and how these tools integrate with each other and with Salesforce/HubSpot
